newsitem.title: UK: UK's Sunderland reports moderate profits.
newsitem.headline: UK's Sunderland reports moderate profits.

text.p: Britain's Sunderland Plc, owner of the football club which was relegated from the English premier league this summer, on Wednesday posted pre-tax profits of 3.08 million stg for the year to May 31, 1997.
The company was listed last December and its share price rose 10 pence to 365p on Wednesday after it announced its profits achieved on a turnover of 13.42 million stg.
The company proposed a final dividend of 3.2 pence a share with earnings per share rising to 57.2 pence a share from last year's loss of 19.8 pence.
Sunderland's chairman Bob Murray said the club had already sold 15,000 season tickets in the current season although its first home game was still more than three weeks away.
"...Most of our valued corporate sponsors have re-affirmed their commitment to Sunderland AFC with 30 executive boxes sold," Murray said.
